# Contributing

Version: 1.0.0
Initial Publication Date: 2026-06-04
Last Updated: 2026-06-04

This repository is not an open source project and is not maintained as a community contribution project.

The repository's Original Materials are governed by the independent license stated in [`LICENSE`](../LICENSE). Public visibility of this repository does not grant permission to copy, reuse, modify, distribute, deploy, incorporate, relicense, create derivative works from, or represent the Original Materials as one's own work.

## Contributions Are Not Accepted

External contributions are not accepted for this repository.

Please do not submit pull requests, patches, source code changes, documentation changes, translations, design assets, generated files, datasets, feature implementations, refactoring proposals, shader rewrites, assets, saved worlds, AI workbench output, or other contribution materials.

Pull requests may be closed without review. Issues or discussions proposing code, text, assets, datasets, generated files, or implementation changes may also be closed without review.

## Issues and Discussions

Issues and discussions, if available, are not a request for external implementation work or external contribution materials.

An issue or discussion may be used only to report a problem, ask a limited question, or request a private contact method for a security report. It must not be used to submit source code, replacement text, design assets, datasets, generated files, shader replacements, or other proposed repository content.

## No Implied Permission

Submitting an issue, pull request, discussion, patch, suggestion, or other material does not grant the submitter any permission to use the Original Materials.

The presence of public GitHub features, including issues, pull requests, forks, clones, downloads, or repository browsing, must not be understood as permission from Kento Konishi to reuse the Original Materials.

## Security Reports

Security vulnerabilities should be reported according to [`SECURITY.md`](./SECURITY.md).

Do not disclose vulnerability details in public issues, public pull requests, public discussions, social media posts, or other public channels.

## Ordinary Application Use

This contributing policy does not restrict ordinary desktop use of the Ludoxel application, including playing in My World, playing Othello, saving local user data, recording ordinary screenshots or screen recordings, or using user-created materials and application output as described in [`LICENSE`](../LICENSE).

## Controlling Terms

This document is a contribution policy for this repository. If this document conflicts with [`LICENSE`](../LICENSE), the English text of [`LICENSE`](../LICENSE) controls for the Original Materials.
